title: Astro Frontmatter Syntax Errors - SSR Failures
summary: Fixed 18 .astro files with imports outside frontmatter fence causing: empty homepage main, contact page raw source, className is not defined errors

fix.rootCause: 18 .astro files had imports placed before opening --- fence, creating invalid dual-frontmatter pattern
fix.solution: Moved all imports inside single frontmatter block for each affected file
